title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Dimensionhole Pharaoh's Servant PSV-069 1st Edition Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for collectors. The Dimensionhole card from the Pharaoh's Servant set is a rare find and comes in 1st edition. It has the attribute of Spell and features a unique Character named Dimensionhole. The card number is PSV-069 and it falls under the Card Type of Spell-Normal. 

The card's color is not specified in the aspects but it is sure to be a valuable addition to any Yu-Gi-Oh! collection. This collectible card game item can be found under the categories of CCG Individual Cards and Toys & Hobbies. Don't miss your chance to own this rare card!
